name: Conflux
description: The event in which blue and white mana flooded into Jund, disrupting its food chain, and the shards overlapped.

description_citations.text: "Jund". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shards complete their merging and Alara is whole again.

citation.text: Shard Convergence (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The conflux nears and Bolas's long machinations are about to triumph.
timeline.quote: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

citation.text: Conflux (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani absorbs the last of the Maelstrom and banishes Bolas from Alara.
timeline.quote: he called up an effigy of Bolas's soul and used it to banish Bolas from Alara

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas foments chaos and destroys the obelisks, accelerating the merging of the shards into the Conflux.
timeline.quote: he accelerated the process until the shards merged in an event known as the Conflux

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shards reunite as a patchwork plane and cultures clash and wars ensue.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolved, cultures clashed, and wars ensued.

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flood into Bant, and the Order of the Skyward Eye sows mistrust and panic.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flooded into Bant, creating havoc.

citation.text: "Bant", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sundering of Alara separates the shards, which drift apart in the Eternities, and during the Conflux move back toward each other.
timeline.quote: the shards separated and continued to drift further apart over time.

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A sinister force conspires to reunite the Shards of Alara, beginning the Conflux.
timeline.quote: A powerful and infinitely sinister force is conspiring to reunite the Shards of Alara.

citation.text: "Conflux", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux, red and green mana flood Esper and its hegemony begins to fall apart.
timeline.quote: When the Conflux happened, red and green mana flooded into Esper.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Conflux floods Grixis with life energies; the undead invade nearby planes.
timeline.quote: the life energies of green and white mana flooded into Grixis

citation.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Half of the Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux .

citation.text: "Human", section "Jund". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis's humans are near extinction by the time of the Conflux.
timeline.quote: but were near extinction by the time of the Conflux

citation.text: "Human", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Conflux floods Jund with blue and white mana, disrupting its food chain and making its creatures less violent and more thoughtful.
timeline.quote: When the Conflux occurred, blue and white mana flooded into Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux black and blue mana flood Naya, and Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: Naya is now flooded with all five colors and Progenitus has awoken, roving the lands for inscrutable purposes.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The merging of the five shards of Alara back into one world, engineered by Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: Conflux: card flavor text (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
